text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- A lack of information from local provinces has made it impossible for the government to finish a nationwide land-use plan.
-- Flooding in central Vietnam has claimed 14 lives and caused extensive damage.
-- Vietnam's embassy in Cambodia has sent a letter to the authorities in Phnom Penh demanding an urgent investigation into the murder of two ethnic Vietnamese in central Kompong Thom province.
-- Vidamco, a $33 million joint-venture between South Korea's Daewoo group and Vietnam's Mechanic Corporation No 7983, commissioned its automobile factory in Hanoi on Thursday.
-- Britain's Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind arrived in Ho Chi Minh city on Thursday, beginning a three-day official visit to Vietnam.
